headline: 本週播客推薦出爐
context: 作家麥考爾・史密斯（Alexander McCall Smith）推出新的短篇故事播客，希望用故事讓聽眾對世界感覺好一點。另外，已故歌手喬治・麥可（George Michael）生前錄製、卻從未發行的專輯《Trojan Souls》，也釋出了90分鐘未經剪輯的錄音室畫面。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Author Alexander McCall Smith’s new series is an attempt to use short fiction to make listeners feel better about the world. Plus, what happened when two London gangsters decided to make a film? While he is best known for his No 1 Ladies’ Detective Agency novels, Alexander McCall Smith has something of a soft spot for short stories, which can “cover a whole sweep of history in a couple of paragraphs”. His new series features a selection of short original works that he hopes will make listeners feel better about the state of the world, beginning with a pleasingly twee tale inspired by a friend’s miniature helicopter landing pad. sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Suing his record label and sick of being a sex symbol, the singer spent 1992 working on the Trojan Souls for stars including Aretha Franklin and Bryan Ferry. Now, newly released studio footage shows him in his creative prime Wham! special: read Andrew Ridgeley on their bizarre 1985 trip to China The George Michael album that never was began in defiance and ended in grief. It was 1992. Mired in a toxic dispute with Sony Records, Michael chose to keep busy and declare his independence by making an album of songs to be sung by several of his musical heroes, including Aretha Franklin, Janet Jackson and Sade Adu, under the alias the Trojan Souls. Michael worked on the album for months until his Brazilian boyfriend Anselmo Feleppa died of Aids in March 1993 and he lost interest in music. It was never revived. Tracks from the sessions have since leaked, along with some of the fly-on-the-wall footage filmed by Michael’s close friend and informal adviser Andros Georgiou, who has spent years trying to get unauthorised clips removed from YouTube and TikTok. Now, months before the 10th anniversary of Michael’s death, he is releasing 90 minutes of unedited video as Trojan Souls – not exactly a film but an unfiltered view of Michael in his creative prime. “I thought these fans were making money from my rights so I decided to stop fighting and get it out there,” Georgiou says. He hopes it will open a door on what he calls, with characteristic hyperbole, “the greatest album never made”. Continue reading...

thread_text:
本週播客推薦出爐

以《The No 1 Ladies' Detective Agency》系列聞名的作家麥考爾・史密斯（Alexander McCall Smith），推出一系列短篇故事播客，希望用故事讓聽眾對這個世界感覺好一點，第一集靈感來自朋友家的迷你直升機停機坪。

另外，已故歌手喬治・麥可（George Michael）1992年秘密錄製、卻從未發行的專輯《Trojan Souls》，如今釋出了90分鐘未經剪輯的錄音室畫面，讓外界一窺他創作巔峰時期的樣貌。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 7 月 27 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
以《The No 1 Ladies' Detective Agency》系列聞名的作家麥考爾・史密斯（Alexander McCall Smith），這週推出一系列短篇故事播客，希望用短篇故事的力量，讓聽眾對這個混亂的世界感覺好一點，第一集的靈感來自一位朋友家裡的迷你直升機停機坪，聽起來就很有他一貫的溫馨小品風格。

同一週，另一則音樂圈的消息是：已故歌手喬治・麥可（George Michael）1992年秘密錄製、卻從未正式發行的專輯《Trojan Souls》，如今釋出了90分鐘未經剪輯的錄音室畫面，讓外界一窺他創作巔峰時期的樣貌，也讓這張「最偉大的未發行專輯」終於有了對外面世的機會。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 27 日發佈的報導。
voice_text:
這週的播客推薦，主打一點溫馨小品。

作家麥考爾・史密斯，就是寫《The No 1 Ladies' Detective Agency》系列的那位，推出了一系列短篇故事播客，希望用故事讓聽眾對這個世界感覺好一點。

同一週，音樂圈也有消息。已故歌手喬治・麥可1992年秘密錄製、卻從未發行的專輯，如今釋出了90分鐘未剪輯的錄音室畫面，讓大家一窺他創作巔峰時期的樣貌。
